races.title: Budget Stabilization Fund
races.description: Statewide constitutional amendment proposed for the 2026 General Election ballot.
races.measureSummary: Raises the cap on the budget stabilization fund from 10% to 25% of general revenue collections and sets required annual transfers, with withdrawals allowed for critical state needs.

races.title: Exemption of Tangible Personal Property on Agricultural Land from Taxation
races.description: Statewide constitutional amendment proposed for the 2026 General Election ballot.
races.measureSummary: Exempts movable equipment and similar tangible personal property habitually on agricultural land from ad valorem taxation, starting with tax years beginning January 1, 2027.

races.title: Increased Homestead Exemption; Lower Cap on Increases in Non-Homestead Property Assessments
races.description: Statewide constitutional amendment proposed for the 2026 General Election ballot.
races.measureSummary: Raises the homestead exemption for non-school taxes to $150,000 in 2027 and $250,000 in 2028 (inflation-adjusted after), lowers the non-homestead assessment increase cap from 10% to 5%, and limits how local governments use property tax revenue, effective January 1, 2027.
